name: Tim-Hinnerk Heuer
story: Tim-Hinnerk Heuer co-authored “Current status and future directions of mobile GIS” for SIRC NZ in 2013, with David Medyckyj-Scott and fellow contributors. Otago’s repository records the paper under mobile devices, location-based services and open-source GIS.
